Scooter Bros Delivery App — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified Phone app, unlocked in Chapter 2

Your registered cars are never far away — an app brings them to you, for a fee.

Full guide — contains spoilers

The Scooter Bros app unlocks during Moses' Chapter 2 mission, alongside Lucia's first registration. Open the app, pick a registered Personal Vehicle and pay the delivery fee, and it is dropped at a nearby delivery location; you can also call Joey the mechanic to deliver cars. Scooter Bros also recovers destroyed or impounded personal vehicles, though recovery costs more than a standard delivery — unregistered cars get no such protection.

Source & evidence

Source: GTA VI: How to Register Personal Cars and Vehicles — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Evidence: Registration walkthrough read in full, including delivery and recovery steps.. Exact delivery/recovery fees are shown in game per vehicle; no fixed price published.
